entry_conditions: Only approve the proposed rule-based side when the supplied completed candles and indicators support that exact strategy.
Block entry if the latest candle has an unusually large opposing wick or the recent data visibly contradict the proposed direction.
If any required information is missing, select UNKNOWN. Do not invent news, order-book data, future prices, or a win probability.
exit_conditions: Close early only when the supplied completed candles clearly invalidate the held position's original strategy.
Otherwise select HOLD or UNKNOWN. Fixed stop, target, and risk limits are always enforced separately by code.
